person: Lan Tran is 41, a pharmacy technician who has been on a Social Security disability benefit and went back to part-time work in March. Her hours were cut in the summer. She also does weekend shifts at a bakery that she has not yet told Social Security about. Her husband works full time, her daughter is starting college, and her mother lives with them. She does all the family's benefit paperwork on her phone and reads official English slowly. She wants to report the right months and the new employer, and she is afraid of a mistake that creates a debt or a fee.
stated_up_front: Hello. I went back to work in March and I think I did not tell Social Security about my second job. Can you help me report my pay for June to September? Please tell me if anything costs money.
